data.body:
GATE RESULTS — closing the loop on the earlier comment that said the default selection was still running.

All four gates were run by the orchestrator on commit 1895c4cee37 (the commit pushed as Gerrit change
1210), on its rebased base of current origin/main. Verified BY EXIT CODE, not by reading output:

  default selection   pytest -m 'not integration and not external' -n 6 --dist worksteal
                      -> 8522 passed, 31 skipped, EXIT 0
  integration tier    pytest tests/integration/test_concurrency_regression.py -m integration
                      -> 25 passed, EXIT 0   (this is the tier holding the two-clone
                         rename/rename reproductions that prove the fix; the default
                         selection EXCLUDES integration, so it alone would not have
                         exercised them)
  make lint           EXIT 0
  make typecheck      EXIT 0

Note on the integration tier specifically: an earlier verification run of mine was reported as clean
while having excluded that tier, which is where 55bc's actual evidence lives. It was re-run
explicitly for that reason, and the 25/25 above includes the new two-clone repros for all three
emit paths.

One additional defect-asserting test was found beyond the two the ticket named:
tests/interfaces/store/test_sidecar_reader.py::test_prune_bound_still_respected_after_prose_fields
asserted 'assert 53 == 50', i.e. that emit() prunes to the retention bound. It was INVERTED in place
rather than deleted — it now pins the append-only invariant (nothing deleted past the bound) while
keeping its real subject, that the prose fields on _slim do not stop the reader returning the newest
record. Renamed to test_emit_appends_past_the_retain_bound_without_deleting.
